objectives: Interpret the dreams of the butler and the baker.
takeaways: Do not interpretations belong to God? The same God gave interpretations to Daniel.
The three branches and the three baskets were three days; the vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another.
The butler was restored and the baker hanged, as Joseph said.
Birthdays are heathen customs; wicked things took place at Pharaoh's and at Herod's.
Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
